title: Parodius: Non-Sense Fantasy - Clouds and Bubbles
description:
The background from the sixth stage of Parodius Da! / Parodius: Non-Sense Fantasy. A very nice cloud background.

It's mandatory to use parallax effect with this background to make the best use of it.

UPDATE: Reripped from scratch. Optimized GFX files, palette and map 16. Created new tiles in the map 16 file to cover the bottom area of the background, while keeping it close to the source material.
